pages.title: Home Is Where You Are
pages.text: Bind one of your supported pets to an animal home.

pages.title: Home Is Where You Are
pages.text: Complete the real home assignment rather than merely placing a decorative block.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Right-click the home, select your pet in its menu and choose Bind. One home holds one pet. Recovery needs the owner online, a loaded valid home and a safe space; you never need to kill a pet for a quest.

pages.title: How it works
pages.text: Right-click the home, select your own pet and choose Bind. Only a committed native assignment counts.

pages.title: How it works
pages.text: After a real native death, a supported pet recovers through its home with full health; no quest asks for death.

pages.title: How it works
pages.text: Recovery requires owner online, valid loaded home and safe position. Failed recovery retries automatically without an invented universal cooldown.
